notes: First research-tier stage for this case; no target_validation.jsonl, trials.jsonl or clinical_evidence.jsonl existed to cross-check against. All 9 tumor-agnostic entries surveyed; 14 of 72 protein targets in scope. ERBB2 is covered inside the her2-ihc-overexpression row by the panel's own no-duplication convention. Four rows are indeterminate for one shared reason: comprehensive sequencing (institutional 468-gene panel, two commercial WES/WTS platforms, WGS) was performed and the reports are not in the derived record, so NTRK, RET, BRAF and somatic HR status are unread rather than untested; one records retrieval closes all four and also names the single unidentified OncoKB-actionable alteration and FGFR3 status. FGFR3 and erdafitinib, the largest genomic gap in this case, appear in neither reference panel, so no survey row could be emitted; the gap is carried in the bundled_with text of the four retrieval rows for the target validator to pick up from profile.json directly. Tissue is scarce (nodal cores at 5-10% tumor content, one fresh-frozen vial), so every new-stain recommendation is bundled onto a single archival block cut and the thin-tail urothelial targets (SLITRK6, PSCA, STEAP1, EPHB4, ITGA3) are deferred rather than ordered.

Narrative frames 20 open rows as three orders: one sequencing-records retrieval, one retrieval of 2026 assay reads, one archival block cut. No index.md yet (PI stage pending), so case-page links inject later; strict mkdocs warnings come only from other tracks' zero-row stub pages.

notes: Highest-yield find came from the Step 1.75 eligibility-gate sweep rather than any antigen-named search: CLSP-1025 (NCT06778863) and NT-175 (NCT05877599) both gate on TP53 R175H presented on HLA-A*02:01, and this patient carries both. Structural traps recorded per row: (1) no prior platinum forecloses TroFuse-031 and the disitamab vedotin cohorts A/B, which is a strategic question for the treating team rather than a biology problem; (2) current trastuzumab deruxtecan is a prior-HER2-therapy exclusion in the disitamab vedotin and zanidatamab protocols and a topoisomerase-payload washout problem for NEOK002; (3) established grade 2+ CIPN excludes CRB-701 and the disitamab vedotin cohorts outright; (4) ILD history is an exclusion in AVZO-103, CRB-701, NEOK002 and EVEREST-2, which makes reconciling the 2026-03 versus 2026-06 chest CT discrepancy an access issue and not only a safety one; (5) SBRT to the only known nodal disease threatens the measurable-unirradiated-lesion requirement across most rows. B7-H3 agents were deliberately excluded: B7-H3 sits in target_validation.jsonl under its own feature key but is not a profile.json targetable_features[] entry, so the mechanism-scope gate excludes the whole ifinatamab deruxtecan class until the profile is amended; this is flagged as the first re-search to run if B7-H3 IHC returns positive. GB-4362 (NCT07484022), an anti-MMAE neutralizing antibody, was dropped on the same gate despite being the most neuropathy-relevant agent in the urothelial registry. MAGE-A4 agents (CDR404 and class) were dropped because tumor expression tested negative in 2024-06. FGFR3 agents enter only through FORAGER-1 cohort B7, which pairs FGFR3 with HER2 expression, and are conditional on the pending sequencing retrieval.
